sentences.text: Aphrodite -LRB- -LSB- æfrəˈdaɪti -RSB- ; Greek : Αφροδίτη -LRB- Afrodíti -RRB- -RRB- is the Greek goddess of love , beauty , pleasure , and procreation .	Greek	Greek mythology	goddess	goddess	love	love	beauty	beauty	pleasure	pleasure	procreation	procreation
She is identified with the planet Venus ; her Roman equivalent is the goddess -LSB- Venus -LRB- mythology -RRB- , Venus -RSB- .	Venus	Venus	goddess	goddess	Roman equivalent	interpretatio romana
Myrtle , roses , doves , sparrows and swans were sacred to her .	Myrtle	Myrtle (plant)

In Hesiod 's Theogony , Aphrodite was created from the sea foam -LRB- aphros -RRB- produced by Uranus 's genitals , which had been severed by Cronus .	Uranus	Uranus (mythology)	Hesiod	Hesiod	Theogony	Theogony	Cronus	Cronus
In Homer 's Iliad , however , she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione .	Zeus	Zeus	Dione	Dione (Titaness/Oceanid)	Homer	Homer	Iliad	Iliad

In Plato -LRB- Symposium , 180e -RRB- , these two origins are said to be of hitherto separate entities : Aphrodite Ourania -LRB- a transcendent , `` Heavenly '' Aphrodite -RRB- and Aphrodite Pandemos -LRB- Aphrodite common to `` all the people '' -RRB- . Despite this , Aphrodite followed her own inclinations , and had many lovers -- both gods , such as Ares , and men , such as Anchises .	Ares	Ares	Anchises	Anchises
